code:
SELECT request_session_id, resource_type, request_mode,
       request_status  -- GRANT or WAIT
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks
WHERE resource_database_id = DB_ID();
caption: Always happening, mostly invisible -- a WAIT row is a session blocked right now.

code:
SELECT blocking_session_id, session_id AS blocked_session_id,
       wait_type, wait_time, wait_resource
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests
WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0;
caption: Chase blocking_session_id back to the row where it's 0 -- the actual root cause.
A cycle SQL Server can't resolve on its own -- it kills a chosen victim.
